title: Databricks_declarative_Pipeline
summary: A Databricks declarative pipeline project that generates synthetic real estate data streams for testing, using SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer fitted on a real estate dataframe to produce a trained synthesizer saved to disk. SDV's single-table GaussianCopulaSynthesizer is imported and run to synthesize the streamed data.
needs: No README details beyond title; unclear if real_estate domain is central use case or just a demo dataset.
